бывать.gloss: to happen, to be (sometimes); to visit

meanings.en: to happen, to exist, there can be
meanings.note: 3rd person бывает = there is / can be

examples.text: У мужчины бывает не только жена.
examples.trans: A man can have more than just a wife.

говорить.gloss: to speak, to say, to talk

meanings.en: must, need to, it is necessary

examples.trans: We need to do even more.

meanings.note: refers back to the subject: 'он держит своё слово' = he keeps his word

examples.trans: How much power does this car have?

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)

examples.trans: If you don't want to, suit yourself.
